mainTopic: Does ביאה create only אירוסין or full נישואין? The גמרא tests this with a ברייתא and with the letter between יוחנן בן בג בג and רבי יהודה בן בתירא about an ארוסה eating תרומה.
overview: The גמרא asks whether קידושין through ביאה creates only אירוסין or full נישואין. It first finishes a ברייתא about a young girl betrothed through ביאה, then tries to prove from its wording that ביאה is only אירוסין. That proof is rejected. Next comes a letter in which יוחנן בן בג בג asks רבי יהודה בן בתירא why a betrothed בת ישראל may eat תרומה, and he answers with a קל וחומר from a שפחה כנענית. The גמרא works out that the letter must be about ביאה without a חופה. Since רבי יהודה בן בתירא treats ביאה as obvious and needs a קל וחומר for כסף, the גמרא argues that ביאה alone makes נישואין. רב נחמן בר יצחק rejects this proof by reading the case as ביאה with a חופה, and he explains why בן בג בג did not accept the קל וחומר. רבינא offers another rejection: the letter was only about a rabbinic worry, סימפון, and the reply about it continues onto the next amud.

steps.title: The rest of the ברייתא about the young girl betrothed through ביאה
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא finishes listing the results of a young girl's קידושין through ביאה. These include laws about טומאה, תרומה, the death penalty for ערוה, and becoming disqualified from כהונה.
steps.simpleTranslation: [If a man is with her while she is a נדה,] he makes the bedding under him impure, like the upper one. If she marries a כהן, she eats תרומה. If any of the forbidden partners in the Torah is with her, they are put to death because of her, and she is not punished. If a man who is unfit for her is with her, he makes her unfit to marry a כהן.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is finishing the quote of a ברייתא it began earlier. The ברייתא lists everything that happens once a girl of three years and a day is betrothed through ביאה. This text is setting up the proof the גמרא will try to draw from it in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא treats her ביאה as fully real. Her husband can give her תרומה if he is a כהן, another man who is with her is liable for אשת איש, and an unfit man makes her a חללה. The important detail for the next step is the phrase 'if she marries a כהן,' which comes after the ביאה was already mentioned.

keyTerms.meaning: Bedding or an object one lies on, which can become impure
The holy portion of produce that only כהנים and their households may eat
Sexual relationships forbidden by the Torah
Men whose relations with a woman make her unfit to marry a כהן
The priesthood (here, being allowed to marry a כהן)

phrases.english: to make impure the bedding underneath, like the upper one.
phrases.notes: This is about a man who is with her while she is a נדה (ויקרא 15:24).

phrases.english: And if she marries a כהן, she eats תרומה.
And if one man is with her
out of all the forbidden relationships in the Torah,
they are put to death because of her, and she is exempt.
phrases.notes: She is exempt because she is still a little girl, and children are not punished.

phrases.aramaic: וְאִם בָּא עָלֶיהָ אֶחָד מִן הַפְּסוּלִין –
phrases.english: And if one of the unfit men is with her,
he has made her unfit for the priesthood.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the ברייתא the גמרא began quoting before this section, on the question of ביאה: אירוסין or נישואין.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A girl betrothed through ביאה is treated as truly betrothed: she can eat תרומה once married to a כהן, other men are liable for her as an ערוה, and a פסול makes her unfit for כהונה.

steps.title: Proof from the wording: ביאה and 'marrying' are listed separately
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא points out that the ברייתא mentions ביאה and then separately mentions 'if she marries.' This suggests that ביאה alone creates only אירוסין.
steps.simpleTranslation: It teaches 'ביאה,' and it also teaches 'she marries'!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tries to answer its question from the wording of the ברייתא. Since 'marries' is a separate, later step, ביאה must have made her only an ארוסה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If ביאה created full נישואין, there would be no need for a separate later stage of 'if she marries a כהן.' Listing them as two things suggests that ביאה is only אירוסין and that נישואין comes afterward.

keyTerms.meaning: It teaches (the ברייתא says)
Relations; here, one of the ways to do קידושין
She marries (full נישואין)

phrases.english: It teaches 'intercourse,'
and it teaches 'she marries'!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws a conclusion from the wording of the ברייתא just quoted.
steps.raayaObject: That ביאה creates only אירוסין, not נישואין
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא lists ביאה and then separately says 'if she marries a כהן'

steps.title: Rejection: the ביאה itself is the marriage to the כהן
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the proof. The ברייתא means that if this ביאה was done by a כהן, then it is her marriage to the כהן, and she eats תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: This is what it means: if this [ביאה] is a marriage to a כהן, she eats תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back the proof from the previous step. 'She marries a כהן' is not a separate later event; it describes the same ביאה when the man is a כהן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The proof depended on reading 'ביאה' and 'marries' as two separate stages. The דחיה reads them as one act, so the ביאה itself can be full נישואין. The question is not decided here, so the גמרא brings a new source in step 4.

keyTerms.meaning: This is what it means (reading the text a new way)
Full marriage, after which the woman lives with her husband

phrases.english: This is what it is saying:
if these are a marriage to a כהן,
phrases.notes: 'These' means the same ביאה the ברייתא already mentioned, not some new event.

phrases.english: she eats תרומה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof drawn in step 2 by rereading the ברייתא.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects only the proof from the wording; it does not decide the question either way.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof assumed 'נישאת' was a separate stage. It can instead describe the ביאה itself when the man is a כהן.
steps.whatToRemember: The ברייתא proves nothing about whether ביאה is אירוסין or נישואין, because 'if she marries a כהן' can describe the ביאה itself.

steps.title: A new source: יוחנן בן בג בג's question to רבי יהודה בן בתירא
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a new ברייתא. יוחנן בן בג בג sent a message to רבי יהודה בן בתירא in נציבין, asking about his view that an ארוסה בת ישראל eats תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: יוחנן בן בג בג once sent a message to רבי יהודה בן בתירא in נציבין: 'I heard that you say a בת ישראל who is betrothed [to a כהן] eats תרומה.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts a new attempt to answer its question, using a different ברייתא. This step only sets up the source; the argument and the proof come next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The discussion is about an ארוסה, a woman who has only אירוסין, and whether she may eat her כהן husband's תרומה. רבי יהודה בן בתירא held that she may. The גמרא will use how he proves this to learn about ביאה.

keyTerms.meaning: A betrothed woman (after אירוסין, before נישואין)
A woman who is not from a כהן family
נציבין, the city where רבי יהודה בן בתירא lived

phrases.english: Come and hear:

phrases.aramaic: וּכְבָר שָׁלַח יוֹחָנָן בֶּן בַּג בַּג
phrases.english: And יוחנן בן בג בג once sent [a message]

phrases.aramaic: אֵצֶל רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן בְּתִירָה לִנְצִיבִין:
phrases.english: to רבי יהודה בן בתירא in נציבין:
I heard about you that you say
a betrothed בת ישראל eats תרומה.
phrases.notes: He means she is betrothed to a כהן, so the question is whether she can eat his תרומה.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: וּכְבָר שָׁלַח יוֹחָנָן בֶּן בַּג בַּג
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the first proof was rejected, the גמרא brings a new source on the same question.
steps.raayaObject: Whether ביאה creates אירוסין or נישואין (the proof is completed in step 10)
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא of יוחנן בן בג בג and רבי יהודה בן בתירא

steps.title: רבי יהודה בן בתירא answers: you should know this from a קל וחומר
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה בן בתירא replies by asking why יוחנן בן בג בג does not hold the same view. Someone as learned as he is should be able to work it out with a קל וחומר.
steps.simpleTranslation: He sent back to him: 'And don't you say so too? I know you are an expert in the inner rooms of Torah. Don't you know how to learn this through a קל וחומר?'
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה בן בתירא answers that his ruling comes from a קל וחומר. The קל וחומר itself is spelled out in the next step, so this line is setting it up.
steps.deeperAnalysis: He does not quote a פסוק. He says simple reasoning, a קל וחומר, proves that an ארוסה eats תרומה. The details of that reasoning are what the גמרא will use to learn about ביאה.

keyTerms.meaning: I know for sure about you
An expert
The 'inner rooms' of Torah: its deep areas
An argument from a lighter case to a stricter one (a fortiori)

phrases.aramaic: שָׁלַח לוֹ: וְאַתָּה אִי אַתָּה אוֹמֵר כֵּן?
phrases.english: He sent to him: And you, don't you say so?
I am confident about you
that you are an expert in the inner rooms of Torah;

phrases.aramaic: לִדְרוֹשׁ בְּקַל וָחוֹמֶר אִי אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ?!
phrases.english: don't you know how to learn through a קל וחומר?!

steps.triggerLanguage: שָׁלַח לוֹ: וְאַתָּה אִי אַתָּה אוֹמֵר כֵּן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: The reply to the question יוחנן בן בג בג asked in step 4.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why does רבי יהודה בן בתירא hold that an ארוסה בת ישראל eats תרומה?
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: It can be learned through a קל וחומר, which is spelled out in step 6.

steps.title: The קל וחומר from a שפחה כנענית, and the limit set by the חכמים
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה בן בתירא lays out his קל וחומר from a שפחה כנענית. He then explains that the חכמים still forbade a ארוסה בת ישראל to eat תרומה until she enters the חופה.
steps.simpleTranslation: A שפחה כנענית does not get to eat תרומה through ביאה, yet once a כהן buys her with money, she eats תרומה. This woman does get to eat תרומה through ביאה, so surely her קידושין money should let her eat too! But what can I do? The חכמים said that a ארוסה בת ישראל does not eat תרומה until she enters the חופה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה בן בתירא finishes his answer to יוחנן בן בג בג. He spells out the קל וחומר that a ארוסה should eat תרומה, then adds that the חכמים blocked it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With a שפחה, money works for תרומה and ביאה does not. With this woman, ביאה already works for תרומה. So money, which works even for the 'weaker' שפחה, should surely work for her too. By Torah law she should eat, but a rabbinic rule holds her back until חופה.

keyTerms.meaning: A non-Jewish maidservant owned by a Jew
Is it not logical? (the classic wording of a קל וחומר)
A woman who has had קידושין but is not yet fully married
The wedding canopy, the step that completes the marriage (נשואין)
Lets her eat

steps.confusionAlert: The limit set by the חכמים is a rabbinic rule. It does not cancel the קל וחומר. רבי יהודה בן בתירא still holds that by Torah law a ארוסה eats תרומה.

phrases.english: And if a Canaanite maidservant
whose intercourse does not let her eat תרומה
phrases.notes: He means intercourse with a כהן. It does not make her his, so it doesn't give her תרומה.

phrases.english: her money lets her eat תרומה
this woman, whose intercourse lets her eat תרומה
is it not logical that her money lets her eat תרומה?
But what can I do
for the Sages said

phrases.aramaic: אֵין אֲרוּסָה בַּת יִשְׂרָאֵל אוֹכֶלֶת בִּתְרוּמָה
phrases.english: a betrothed daughter of a non-כהן does not eat תרומה
until she enters the wedding canopy.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the קל וחומר that step 5 said יוחנן בן בג בג should have worked out himself.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: By a קל וחומר from a שפחה כנענית, a ארוסה should eat תרומה through קידושין money. Only a rabbinic rule delays it until חופה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: By Torah law a ארוסה בת ישראל eats תרומה. The חכמים forbade it until חופה.

steps.title: What case is he talking about? Not one with a חופה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what case the קל וחומר is about. It rules out a case where both ביאה and כסף are followed by חופה, since then she eats תרומה in both anyway.
steps.simpleTranslation: What are the circumstances? If he means ביאה followed by חופה and כסף followed by חופה, then in both cases she certainly eats תרומה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now asks which exact case רבי יהודה בן בתירא meant. It tests the first option and throws it out, which sets up the next options.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If there was a חופה in both cases, she is fully married either way. Then there is no question about כסף, and no need for a קל וחומר. So this cannot be what he meant.

keyTerms.meaning: What are the circumstances? What case is this?
Together with (followed by) a חופה
In both of them

phrases.english: What are the circumstances?
If it is intercourse together with a wedding canopy
and money together with a wedding canopy
in both cases she certainly eats!

steps.triggerLanguage: הֵיכִי דָמֵי? אִי בְּבִיאָה שֶׁעַל יְדֵי חוּפָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts sorting through the possible cases behind the קל וחומר in step 6.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which exact case of ביאה and כסף the קל וחומר compares.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Not both with חופה, because then she would clearly eat in both.

steps.title: Not ביאה with a חופה against כסף without one
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא tries a second option, ביאה with חופה against כסף without חופה. It rejects it because the comparison would be unfair: two steps on one side and only one on the other.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, maybe he means ביאה with a חופה and כסף without a חופה? But then here there are two things, and here only one!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tests a second possible case and rejects it too.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the ביאה side also had a חופה, then the ביאה case has two steps (ביאה plus חופה) while the כסף case has only one. You cannot build a קל וחומר from a 'stronger' case that only won because it had an extra step.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather (trying another option)
Two
One

phrases.english: Rather, intercourse together with a wedding canopy
and money not together with a wedding canopy
here there are two, and here there is one!
phrases.notes: The first 'here' is the ביאה case (ביאה plus חופה). The second is the כסף case (money alone).

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאֶלָּא, בְּבִיאָה שֶׁעַל יְדֵי חוּפָּה, וְכֶסֶף שֶׁלֹּא עַל יְדֵי חוּפָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Second option, after step 7 ruled out the first.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects reading the קל וחומר as ביאה with חופה against כסף without חופה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The two sides are uneven: two steps against one, so the קל וחומר would not hold.

steps.title: So he means both without a חופה
steps.stepSummary: The other options are gone, so the גמרא concludes he must mean ביאה without חופה and כסף without חופה.
steps.simpleTranslation: So isn't it that he means ביאה without a חופה and כסף without a חופה?
steps.whatsHappening: Having ruled out the other cases, the גמרא settles on the only one left. This sets up the proof in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now both sides are equal: one act each, with no חופה. Within this case, רבי יהודה בן בתירא takes it as obvious that ביאה lets her eat תרומה, while for כסף he needs a קל וחומר.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather, is it not that... (leads into the remaining option)
Without a חופה

phrases.aramaic: אֶלָּא לָאו בְּבִיאָה שֶׁלֹּא עַל יְדֵי חוּפָּה
phrases.english: Rather, is it not intercourse without a wedding canopy
and money without a wedding canopy?

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא לָאו בְּבִיאָה שֶׁלֹּא עַל יְדֵי חוּפָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Concludes the case analysis begun in step 7, after steps 7 and 8 ruled out the other options.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The קל וחומר compares ביאה and כסף, both without חופה.

steps.title: Proof that ביאה alone creates נשואין
steps.stepSummary: If ביאה creates נשואין, it makes sense that it is obviously stronger than כסף. If ביאה only created קידושין, there would be no reason to treat ביאה as obvious and כסף as doubtful.
steps.simpleTranslation: It works if you say ביאה creates נשואין: that is why he finds it obvious that ביאה is stronger than כסף. But if you say ביאה only creates קידושין, why is he sure about this one and unsure about that one?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes the proof it started in step 4. רבי יהודה בן בתירא's view only makes sense if ביאה by itself creates נשואין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: He treats ביאה (without חופה) as obviously letting her eat תרומה, and needs a קל וחומר for כסף. If both only made her a ארוסה, they would be equal and his different treatment would make no sense. So ביאה must create full נשואין.

keyTerms.meaning: It works out well if...
Full marriage
It is obvious to him
Stronger
He is unsure about it
What is the difference?

steps.whatToRemember: The proof says that for רבי יהודה בן בתירא, ביאה alone, even without חופה, creates נשואין, since he treats ביאה as obvious for תרומה while כסף needs a קל וחומר. רב נחמן בר יצחק (step 11) and רבינא (step 15) each push back on this proof.
steps.whyThisMatters: This brings back the question from step 2 (does ביאה create only אירוסין?), now with a proof that ביאה creates נשואין.

phrases.english: It works well if you say it creates full marriage
that is why it is obvious to him
that intercourse is stronger for her than money.
But if you say it creates only betrothal
what is different here, that it is obvious to him
and what is different here, that he is unsure?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the case settled in step 9 to complete the proof that began in step 4.
steps.raayaObject: That ביאה alone creates נשואין, not only אירוסין.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא of יוחנן בן בג בג and רבי יהודה בן בתירא: ביאה is treated as obvious for תרומה, while כסף needs a קל וחומר.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: If this proof stands, then for רבי יהודה בן בתירא ביאה without חופה makes her a full wife. The steps that follow offer other readings that undo the proof.

steps.title: רב נחמן בר יצחק brings back the rejected reading
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן בר יצחק says the קל וחומר really is about ביאה with חופה against כסף without חופה. The 'two against one' complaint does not break it.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב נחמן בר יצחק said: Actually, the case is ביאה done with a חופה against כסף done without a חופה. And as for your complaint that one side has two steps and the other only one, there is still a valid קל וחומר.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן בר יצחק goes back to the option the גמרא threw out in step 8 and says it was right after all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The complaint was that ביאה plus חופה is two steps, while כסף alone is one step, so the comparison seems unfair. רב נחמן בר יצחק says the קל וחומר still holds. The next step shows why: with a שפחה כנענית, even two steps (ביאה plus חופה) do not let her eat תרומה, yet one step (כסף) does.

keyTerms.meaning: Actually, I will tell you (I am going back to an option that was rejected)
two (here: two steps, ביאה plus חופה)
one (here: one step, כסף alone)
in any event, still

steps.confusionAlert: This is not a new case. It is exactly the option rejected in step 8. רב נחמן בר יצחק is defending it, so it is not the conclusion of step 9.
steps.whyThisMatters: If the קל וחומר is about ביאה with חופה, then step 10's proof that ביאה by itself makes נשואין no longer comes from this source.

phrases.english: Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said:
Actually, I will say to you
that it is about ביאה done by means of a חופה
and money not done by means of a חופה.
And as for what you said:
phrases.notes: He is answering the complaint the גמרא made back in step 8.

phrases.english: "Here there are two, and here there is one"
there is still a קל וחומר in any event.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן בַּר יִצְחָק: לְעוֹלָם אֵימָא לָךְ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof of step 10 by reviving the reading rejected in step 8: the קל וחומר is about ביאה with חופה against כסף without חופה, so nothing is proven about ביאה alone.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Defends a rejected reading by showing the objection does not stop the קל וחומר.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Two steps against one cannot make a fair קל וחומר.
steps.terutzMaskana: The קל וחומר still works even with the unequal number of steps.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the proof from the letter that ביאה alone creates נשואין. It does not decide the question itself.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof assumed the case was ביאה without חופה. The case can instead be ביאה with חופה, and the 'two against one' objection does not stop the קל וחומר, because even two steps do not help a שפחה.

steps.title: How the letter reads under this approach
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא restates the letter of רבי יהודה בן בתירא as רב נחמן בר יצחק understands it: a שפחה's ביאה fails even with a חופה, but her כסף works alone.
steps.simpleTranslation: This is what he sent him: A שפחה כנענית cannot eat תרומה through ביאה, even with a חופה, yet her purchase money lets her eat without a חופה. So this woman, whose ביאה with a חופה does let her eat תרומה, should surely be able to eat תרומה through her כסף without a חופה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows how the wording of the letter fits רב נחמן בר יצחק's reading, by adding 'with a חופה' to the ביאה side.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With a שפחה, even two steps (ביאה plus חופה) do not help, yet one step (כסף) does, so כסף is the stronger tool. A בת ישראל is better off, since her ביאה with a חופה does work. So her כסף should surely work, even without a חופה. That is why the 'two against one' imbalance does not matter.

keyTerms.meaning: and this is what he sent him (this is how to read the letter)
if even (the opening word of a קל וחומר)
is it not logical? (the closing of a קל וחומר)
lets her eat

phrases.english: And this is what he sent him:
If a Canaanite maidservant,
whose ביאה does not allow her to eat תרומה
even by means of a חופה,
still, her money allows her to eat without a חופה,
then this woman, whose ביאה allows her to eat תרומה
by means of a חופה,
is it not logical
that her money should allow her to eat תרומה without a חופה?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the letter's wording according to the reading given in step 11.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: How the original letter reads if ביאה is with a חופה.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The letter compares ביאה with a חופה against כסף without a חופה, using the שפחה כנענית as the model.

steps.title: The rabbinic ban, explained by עולא's concern
steps.stepSummary: The letter continues: even so, the חכמים said an ארוסה בת ישראל does not eat תרומה until the חופה. The reason is עולא's concern.
steps.simpleTranslation: But what can I do, since the חכמים said that a betrothed בת ישראל does not eat תרומה until she enters the חופה, because of עולא's reason.
steps.whatsHappening: The letter admits that even though the קל וחומר works by Torah law, the חכמים stopped her from eating, and the גמרא names the reason: עולא's concern.
steps.deeperAnalysis: By Torah law, her כסף should let her eat תרומה. The חכמים still stopped it. The added words 'משום דעולא' tell us the ban is a rabbinic safeguard, not a flaw in the קל וחומר.

keyTerms.meaning: what can I do (I have to follow the חכמים)
a woman who has had קידושין but not yet נשואין
because of עולא's reason

phrases.english: But what can I do,
since the חכמים said:
a betrothed בת ישראל does not
eat תרומה
until she enters the חופה,
because of עולא's reason.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲבָל מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה שֶׁהֲרֵי אָמְרוּ חֲכָמִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the restated letter and adds the reason for the rabbinic ban.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: By Torah law, כסף would let an ארוסה eat תרומה. The חכמים forbade it until the חופה because of עולא's concern.

steps.title: Why בן בג בג did not accept the comparison
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why בן בג בג did not accept this קל וחומר. It answers that buying a שפחה is a complete acquisition, while קידושין leaves part of the acquisition still to come.
steps.simpleTranslation: And בן בג בג, why does he not accept it? With a שפחה כנענית, the buyer leaves nothing out of the acquisition. Here, he leaves part of the acquisition still undone.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why בן בג בג, who sent the question, did not accept this קל וחומר, and gives his reason for rejecting it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When a master buys a שפחה with money, she is fully his, so it makes sense that she eats תרומה right away. קידושין money is only a first stage, because the נשואין stage has not happened yet. So the money of קידושין is weaker, and the two cases cannot be compared.

keyTerms.meaning: left over, held back
her acquisition
regarding, in the case of

steps.whatToRemember: The קל וחומר from a שפחה כנענית fails for בן בג בג because buying a שפחה is a full acquisition, while קידושין is only partial until the חופה.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows the basic difference between קנין of a slave and קידושין: קידושין is a first stage that still waits for נשואין.

phrases.english: And בן בג בג?
phrases.notes: He means: why didn't בן בג בג, who asked the question, accept this קל וחומר?

phrases.english: Regarding a Canaanite maidservant,
he does not leave anything out of her acquisition;
here, he leaves part of her acquisition undone.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains why the questioner did not accept the קל וחומר that was just laid out.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why בן בג בג did not accept the קל וחומר from the שפחה כנענית.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A שפחה is acquired completely, but קידושין is a partial acquisition, so the comparison fails.

steps.title: רבינא: the question was only rabbinic
steps.stepSummary: רבינא says that by Torah law בן בג בג was sure a betrothed בת ישראל eats תרומה. His letter asked only about a rabbinic issue.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבינא said: By Torah law it was totally obvious to him that she eats. What he asked about was rabbinic law.
steps.whatsHappening: רבינא gives a new answer to why בן בג בג seemed unsure about the קל וחומר. He says בן בג בג had no doubt about the Torah law, and his letter was only about a rabbinic concern.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבינא gives a second way to undo the proof of step 10, different from רב נחמן בר יצחק's. In his reading, nobody was ever unsure about the Torah law, because her כסף clearly lets her eat. The letter asked only about a rabbinic worry, so the contrast between ביאה being 'obvious' and כסף being 'doubtful' teaches nothing about whether ביאה makes נשואין.

keyTerms.meaning: By Torah law
By rabbinic law
It is completely obvious to him

phrases.english: Ravina said:
By Torah law, it is completely obvious to him that she eats,
phrases.notes: "Him" is בן בג בג, and "she" is a בת ישראל betrothed to a כהן with money.

phrases.english: and it is about rabbinic law that he sent to him.

steps.triggerLanguage: רָבִינָא אָמַר: מִדְּאוֹרָיְיתָא – מִיפְשָׁט פְּשִׁיטָא לֵיהּ דְּאָכְלָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: An alternative to רב נחמן בר יצחק (steps 11–14) for rejecting the proof of step 10: by Torah law כסף clearly lets her eat, so the letter was only about a rabbinic concern, and it implies nothing about ביאה creating נשואין.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reframing: the question moves from Torah law to rabbinic law.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: That בן בג בג doubted whether כסף alone lets her eat תרומה by Torah law.
steps.terutzMaskana: By Torah law she eats. The letter asked only about a rabbinic concern.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the proof of step 10 by reframing the letter as a rabbinic question. It does not decide whether ביאה makes נשואין.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof assumed בן בג בג doubted whether כסף works by Torah law. In fact he had no Torah-level doubt; he asked only about סימפון.

steps.title: The letter: aren't you worried about a hidden flaw?
steps.stepSummary: In רבינא's version, בן בג בג writes: I heard you let a betrothed בת ישראל eat תרומה. Aren't you worried about סימפון?
steps.simpleTranslation: This is what he sent: I heard that you say a betrothed בת ישראל eats תרומה, and you are not worried about סימפון.
steps.whatsHappening: רבינא now spells out what the letter actually said in his version. The question is about סימפון, a flaw that could be found later and cancel the קידושין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the כהן later finds a hidden flaw in her, the קידושין could turn out to have been invalid from the start. Then she would have eaten תרומה when she was not allowed to. בן בג בג asks why רבי יהודה בן בתירא is not worried about this.

keyTerms.meaning: A flaw found later that cancels a deal or קידושין back to the start
A non-כהן's daughter who is betrothed (but not yet married) to a כהן
You are concerned

phrases.english: And this is what he sent to him:
I heard about you that you say
a betrothed daughter of a non-priest eats תרומה,
and you are not concerned about סימפון.
phrases.notes: סימפון is a flaw that turns up later and could undo the קידושין, so her eating would turn out to have been forbidden.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָכִי שְׁלַח לֵיהּ: שָׁמַעְתִּי עָלֶיךָ שֶׁאַתָּה אוֹמֵר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the rabbinic question that רבינא mentioned in step 15.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why is there no concern of סימפון when a betrothed בת ישראל eats תרומה?

steps.title: The reply: a קל וחומר from a שפחה כנענית
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה בן בתירא answers that we do not worry about סימפון with a שפחה כנענית bought with money. So surely we should not worry about it with a betrothed בת ישראל.
steps.simpleTranslation: He sent back: Don't you say so too? I know you are an expert in the inner parts of Torah. Don't you know how to make a קל וחומר? A שפחה כנענית's ביאה does not let her eat תרומה, yet her purchase money does, and we don't worry about סימפון. This woman's ביאה does let her eat. Isn't it logical that her money lets her eat too, and that we should not worry about סימפון?
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה בן בתירא answers the question about סימפון with a קל וחומר. The same weaker-to-stronger argument as before now also covers the worry about סימפון.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A שפחה is weaker, because ביאה does not help her at all. Still, her purchase money lets her eat, even though a hidden flaw could also cancel her sale. A betrothed woman is stronger, because her ביאה does work. So her כסף should work too, and the worry about סימפון should not stop her.

keyTerms.meaning: A non-Jewish maidservant owned by a Jew
I know you to be, I consider you
The inner parts of the Torah, its deep areas
Is it not logical? (the closing words of a קל וחומר)

phrases.aramaic: שְׁלַח לֵיהּ: וְאַתָּה אִי אַתָּה אוֹמֵר כֵּן?
phrases.english: He sent to him: And you, do you not say so?

phrases.aramaic: מוּחְזְקַנִי בְּךָ שֶׁאַתָּה בָּקִי בְּחַדְרֵי תוֹרָה,
phrases.english: I know you to be an expert in the inner chambers of Torah;

phrases.aramaic: לִדְרוֹשׁ בְּקַל וָחוֹמֶר אִי אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ?!
phrases.english: do you not know how to expound a קל וחומר?!
Now, if a Canaanite maidservant,
whose intercourse does not let her eat תרומה,
her money lets her eat תרומה,
and we are not concerned about סימפון,
this one, whose intercourse does let her eat תרומה,
phrases.notes: "This one" is the betrothed בת ישראל.

phrases.english: is it not logical that her money lets her eat תרומה,
and that we should not be concerned about סימפון?

steps.triggerLanguage: לִדְרוֹשׁ בְּקַל וָחוֹמֶר אִי אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the סימפון question from step 16 with a קל וחומר.
steps.raayaObject: That the worry about סימפון should not stop a betrothed בת ישראל from eating תרומה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A קל וחומר from a שפחה כנענית, whose purchase money lets her eat תרומה without any worry about סימפון.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: By a קל וחומר from a שפחה כנענית, whose purchase money lets her eat תרומה with no worry about סימפון, a betrothed בת ישראל's כסף should let her eat without worrying about סימפון.

steps.title: But the חכמים said she may not eat
steps.stepSummary: Even after his קל וחומר, רבי יהודה בן בתירא says his hands are tied, because the חכמים ruled that a betrothed בת ישראל does not eat תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: But what can I do? The חכמים said: a betrothed בת ישראל does not eat תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה בן בתירא admits that, in practice, the חכמים forbade her to eat. The sentence continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: His logic says she should be allowed to eat, but a ruling of the חכמים overrides it in practice. So in רבינא's version, the practical rule is still rabbinic, even though the Torah law and the קל וחומר about סימפון both point toward allowing her.

keyTerms.meaning: What can I do? (my hands are tied)
The Sages, whose rabbinic ruling decides the practice

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think רבי יהודה בן בתירא is taking back his קל וחומר. He still holds that his logic is right. He is only saying that the rabbinic ruling decides what happens in practice.

phrases.english: But what can I do,
for the Sages have said:

phrases.aramaic: אֲרוּסָה בַּת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵינָהּ אוֹכֶלֶת בִּתְרוּמָה
phrases.english: a betrothed daughter of a non-priest does not eat תרומה

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲבָל מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה שֶׁהֲרֵי אָמְרוּ חֲכָמִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Limits the קל וחומר of step 17 in practice by citing the ruling of the חכמים.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: By rabbinic ruling, a betrothed בת ישראל does not eat תרומה, even though logic would allow it.
